items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Eddie Durham. Eddie Durham. ... INTERVIEWEE: Yeah, he was the first and he also helped Charlie Christian.

ctx.x: ‘Cause you said Ernie, so that threw me, I was thinking Ernie Wilkins, I know it’s not Ernie Wilkins.
But Eddie Durham was the first, yeah, he was the first.
